sanitise research input (#2852)

* feat(sanitise): add stripControlChars, stripInvisibleUnicode, and sanitizeUserContent helpers

Add two new sanitisation helper functions and a composed pipeline
function to the shared sanitize-context library:

- stripControlChars — removes ASCII control characters (except \t, \n, \r)
  and Unicode line/paragraph separators (\u2028, \u2029)
- stripInvisibleUnicode — removes zero-width/joiners/bidi marks/BOM
  (\u200B-\u200F, \u2060-\u2064, \uFEFF)
- sanitizeUserContent — composed pipeline running all three filters
  in order: stripHtmlComments → stripControlChars → stripInvisibleUnicode

All three new functions are exported alongside existing stripHtmlComments
and findResearchComment. All existing tests continue to pass.

Implements tasks 1.1, 1.2, 1.3 of the ci-factory-input-sanitisation change.

- write-context-files.js: research-factory and reproducer-factory copies

  prior-comment env var is unified to PRIOR_FACTORY_COMMENT and the

  now uses the shared lib/factory-runners/check-duplicate-pr.js (already

  research-factory and the shared finalize-gate runner honours it.

  lib/runners/gate.js keyed off a new GATE_NAME env. Each gate spec
  declares its env-var prefix and which lib evaluator to call.

behavioural changes for any factory or gate.

- Correct the proposal's incidental claim that scripts/auto-approve/
  uses the gh CLI; it actually uses go-github with oauth2 (matches the
  design.md decision).

No runtime behaviour change; make workflow-test still passes;
npx openspec validate migrate-changelog-engine-to-go --strict clean.
